relatedItems.originalTitle: Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end. Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring afte...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end.
Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring after losing speed on the straights.
The team are investigating both issues.
detailZh:
我们的阿塞拜疆大奖赛提前结束了。
由于疑似水压问题，斯特罗尔被要求将赛车停在赛道上，而阿隆索则因在直道上失去速度而退赛。
车队正在调查这两个问题。
detailEn:
Our #AzerbaijanGP comes to an early end.
Lance was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue, with Fernando retiring after losing speed on the straights.
The team are investigating both issues.
keyPointsZh: 斯特罗尔被要求将车停在赛道上，疑似水压问题。
阿隆索退赛的原因是在直道上损失了速度。
车队表示正在对两起退赛的原因展开调查。
keyPointsEn: Lance Stroll was asked to stop the car on track due to a suspected water pressure issue.
Fernando Alonso retired after losing speed on the straights.
The team said they are investigating both issues.

relatedItems.titleZh: 斯特罗尔赛车停在赛道上，结束阿塞拜疆大奖赛征程
relatedItems.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车队官方发布消息称，斯特罗尔的赛车在赛道上停下，他的阿塞拜疆大奖赛就此结束，车队正在调查问题原因。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Lance has stopped on track bringing his #AzerbaijanGP to an end. The team are investigating the issue.
relatedItems.summaryEn: Lance has stopped on track bringing his #AzerbaijanGP to an end. The team are investigating the issue.
detailZh: 斯特罗尔的赛车在赛道上停下，他的阿塞拜疆大奖赛就此结束。车队正在调查该问题。（来源：阿斯顿·马丁车队官方X账号）
detailEn: Lance has stopped on track bringing his #AzerbaijanGP to an end. The team are investigating the issue.
keyPointsZh: 车队正在调查导致赛车停下的问题原因
keyPointsEn: The team is investigating the cause of the issue that led to the car stopping
